worldcombat.skill.leafage.summary: A handful of tender leaves is shaken loose and flung in a small fan: each leaf flies a short arc, the first one to connect deals the damage, and the rest tumble to the ground. Cheap, quick to throw and quick to reuse; the heavy form throws fewer, heavier leaves farther, the flurry form throws more, lighter ones to cover movement.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.use.0: Cheap, fast ranged chip you can throw again and again
worldcombat.skill.leafage.use.1: Cover a target that keeps walking with a fan of leaves
worldcombat.skill.leafage.use.2: Finish a weakened target at close range
worldcombat.skill.leafage.description.0: A fan of %2$s leaves is thrown, but only one hit counts: the first leaf to strike an enemy deals about %1$s physical damage; the target's defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.description.1: Range %1$s blocks, a %2$s degree fan, with leaves flying a short arc at %3$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.description.2: Each leaf has a %1$s block cross-section for hits.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.description.3: Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; the PP 40 feel, very quick to reuse.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.heavy.on: Heavy form: power x1.3, single-leaf cross-section x1.35, range x1.12, but leaf count x0.55, a narrower fan, wind-up +1 tick and cooldown +5 ticks - fewer, heavier leaves thrown farther and tighter.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.heavy.off: Flurry form: more leaves, a wider fan, a faster throw and reuse, but lighter per leaf, a narrower single-leaf cross-section and shorter range - use the dense fan to cover movement.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.growth.0: From level %1$s the single-leaf power rises to %2$s and the count to %3$s leaves.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.growth.1: From level %1$s the single-leaf power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.leafage.preference.hea: On (heavy): power x1.3, cross-section x1.35, range x1.12, but leaf count x0.55, a narrower fan, wind-up +1 tick, cooldown +5 ticks. Off (flurry, default): more leaves, a wider fan, faster throw and reuse, but lighter per leaf, a narrower cross-section and shorter range.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: targets below 40% health rank higher, to finish them with a handful of leaves; off: all targets score the same.
